    Sign in

    Use your Warden Chat account. Your coins, diamonds and membership are shared with Wildcard Chess and SirSC's other games, and the same account plays friends online.

    Changing your password or deleting your account happens on Warden Chat.

    Paused

    • Putt: press anywhere, drag back, and let go. Drag further for more power.
    • Keys: left and right aim, up and down set power, Space putts.
    • Camera: C or Whole hole to see everything; Q and E or the arrows turn; scroll or pinch to zoom.
    • Hazards (water, flowerbeds, lava and the edges of the Abyss) cost a stroke and put you back where you putted from.
    • Stuck? After 8 strokes (par + 5 in the Abyss) you can keep putting, or press Give up (or G) to end the hole with 2 penalty strokes.
